caption: A vibrant, spicy ramen broth fills a white bowl, topped with shredded bean sprouts and fresh greens. The rich, reddish-orange broth glistens under bright light, set against a dark tray with a price tag visible.

segments_info.text: Dark brown tray with glossy finish, smooth surface, slightly curved edges, and visible label corner.
Chashu pork: tender, thinly sliced, with glistening, slightly fatty surface and visible marbling.
The spicy broth is reddish-orange, glossy, and contains visible noodles, bean sprouts, and green herbs floating on its surface.
White ceramic bowl with subtle speckled pattern, smooth glossy surface, and slightly raised rim with faint printed text.
